flow-definition.description: Build container images and deploy the DopaX API and staff console to App Service. Does not run the R5 bootstrap.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ENVIRONMENT
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Target environment. Names the resource group dopax-<env>-rg.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: IMAGE_TAG
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Image tag. Leave empty to use the git short SHA.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DEPLOY_APPS
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: After pushing images, deploy the API and staff console.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: LEGACY_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Read-only Drive folder for the legacy corpus. Optional.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Inlined into the admin client bundle at build time. Public identifier, not a credential.
